TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Payatas, Quezon City

We sincerely apologize for the traffic inconvenience caused by our pipe replacement works along Payatas Road (from Soliven St. to Motorola St.).

We’re upgrading old 300mm pipes to larger 500mm and 600mm lines to improve water pressure and reliability in the area. Works are done from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. daily, with one inner lane (toward Montalban) closed during weekend restoration. Expect stop-and-go traffic while works are ongoing.

We’re coordinating with the Quezon City Traffic and Transport Management Department (QC TTMD), Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA), and barangay officials to manage traffic flow. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding as we complete this essential project for better water service in Payatas.
